# Talkaside

> AI interview assistant and live call translator for Windows 10 and 11. Talkaside listens to a call in the app the user already uses (Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet and others), writes a live transcript, suggests answers during job interviews based on the user's CV and the job description, and translates both sides of the conversation in real time. Official site and download: https://talkaside.com/

## Facts

- Platform: Windows 10 and 11, 64 bit. No macOS, Linux or mobile version.
- Download: https://talkaside.com/download (always the current Windows installer).
- Price: free 5 day demo, one activation per device. Paid licences for 7 days, 30 days or one year at https://talkaside.com/
- Call apps: Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet and other apps, because Talkaside captures the call audio from Windows. The other person installs nothing.
- Interview help: two AI assistants read the live transcript with the user's CV, the job description and the user's own Q&A bank, and suggest an answer.
- Translation: both sides of the call are transcribed and translated in real time. Optional translated voice for the user's replies; My Voice uses a local voice profile and needs an NVIDIA GPU.
- History: transcripts and sessions are stored on the user's PC. Call recording is optional and off by default.
- Float panel: an always on top window for suggestions, built to stay out of supported screen captures.
- Privacy: no Talkaside server in the audio path. Speech and text go only to the speech and AI providers the user configures, and those providers bill the user separately.
